summary: Created sanitized real-client trace regression fixtures (5 ICS + 7 HTTP traces) with a 12-test verification suite, and added CalDAV/Apple Calendar deployment and user-setup documentation to docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.

The 12-test suite in apple_calendar_fixtures.rs loads every fixture and asserts ICS round-trip + trace well-formedness/sanitization.
docs/DEPLOYMENT.md now has a 'Connect an Apple Calendar client' section and an Architecture note referencing the CalDAV surface.
